name: Chandigarh
intro: Chandigarh's mix of IT parks, education providers and healthcare groups makes it one of North India's most competitive markets for online visibility.

name: Mohali
intro: Mohali is home to a fast-growing startup community and the IT City cluster, where businesses compete for both customers and talent online.

name: Delhi
intro: Delhi NCR businesses operate in one of the largest and most crowded digital markets in the country, where speed and relevance decide who gets the click.

name: Mumbai
intro: Mumbai's finance, media and retail sectors demand digital experiences that are fast, trustworthy and built to scale.

name: Bengaluru
intro: Bengaluru's product companies and SaaS startups expect engineering-grade websites that perform as well as the products they sell.
